typographie_suggestion.explanation: The typeface features the high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and flat, unbracketed serifs characteristic of the "Modern" or Didone style (popularized by Didot and Bodoni), which was the standard for formal French printing in the late 18th and early 19th centuries.
